items.title: PharmaTrack
items.description: Degree Final Year Project: AI-enabled clinical decision support system for community pharmacies
items.problem: Community pharmacies often manage patient health and medication records manually, which leads to scattered records, slower check-ins, and harder follow-up on patients who need monitoring.
items.role: Full-stack Laravel developer and QA tester: designed and built the system, integrated face recognition, OCR, and risk prediction, and planned and ran UAT.
features: Face-recognition kiosk check-in for registered patients
Admin command center for staff accounts, patient overview, and reports
OCR autofill that reads vitals and lab values from check-up reports
Health risk prediction using a decision tree model (scikit-learn)
Patient portal with medication schedule, check-up history, and reminders
Health summary PDF download and email
items.outcome: Achieved a 100% pass rate across 26 UAT test cases with 8 respondents, validating the core pharmacist, admin, and patient workflows.

items.title: Bicycle Renting System
items.problem: Students and users need a clearer way to check bicycle availability, submit rental information, and manage bookings without relying on manual records.
items.role: Full-stack student developer responsible for interface design, form flow, and database-backed rental records.
features: Bicycle listing and rental request flow
User-friendly booking form structure
Database storage for rental information
Responsive pages for desktop and mobile users
items.outcome: Delivered a diploma final year project that demonstrates CRUD flow, form handling, and practical web application structure.

items.title: District Office Web System
items.problem: Internal administrative users needed support maintaining web pages and improving usability for official district office workflows.
items.role: Intern web developer assisting with maintenance, UI improvements, troubleshooting, and responsive updates.
features: Internal web page maintenance
Responsive interface improvements
Issue checking and troubleshooting support
Content and layout updates for official use
items.outcome: Gained real workplace exposure by supporting internal government web systems and collaborating with senior staff.
